title: Top 5 Most DEADLIEST Cosmic Events In The Universe
hook: Number one could sterilize entire galaxies in seconds.

items.name: Solar Flare
items.stat: A single X-class flare releases energy equal to billions of hydrogen bombs in minutes.

items.name: Coronal Mass Ejection
items.stat: The 1859 Carrington Event hurled billions of tons of plasma at Earth, sparking fires in telegraph stations.

items.name: Supernova
items.stat: A dying star briefly outshines its entire galaxy, blasting matter outward at 30,000 km per second.

items.name: Kilonova (Neutron Star Merger)
items.stat: Colliding neutron stars forge gold and platinum while rippling spacetime with gravitational waves.

items.name: Gamma-Ray Burst
items.stat: The most powerful explosions known—one can release more energy in seconds than the Sun will in 10 billion years.
